headline: Banxico's Heath Warns Minimum Wage Hikes Hinder Service Inflation Slowdown
summary: Bank of Mexico Deputy Governor Jonathan Heath stated that minimum wage policy poses a barrier to bringing services inflation down toward the central bank's 3% target by late 2027.
why: The Bank of Mexico (Banxico) sets benchmark interest rates to manage price stability in Latin America's second-largest economy.

impacts.name: Mexican Peso interest rate
impacts.why: Services inflation persistence reduces the likelihood of rapid central bank policy rate cuts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
